items.author: Dan Koe
items.title: AI for scaling one-person businesses
items.content: The future isn't AI replacing creators. It's creators using AI to do the work of 10 people. I now produce 5x more content with better quality using AI for drafting, editing, and ideation. The key: AI handles volume, you handle voice and strategy.

items.author: Justin Welsh
items.title: LinkedIn AI content strategy
items.content: Here's what 2 years of data shows: AI-assisted content outperforms if you edit it heavily. My process: AI generates 3 drafts, I pick the best hook, rewrite in my voice, add personal stories. Result: 10M impressions/month, 90% less time writing.

items.author: Sahil Bloom
items.title: AI writing frameworks
items.content: The best creators use AI as a sparring partner, not a writer. I feed it rough ideas, it challenges my thinking, then I write. This process surfaces better angles and stronger arguments than either human or AI alone could produce.

items.author: Lenny Rachitsky
items.title: The AI-Native Newsletter Stack: How Top Creators Use AI
items.content: Survey of 500+ newsletter creators shows 83% now use AI tools. Most common: research automation (ChatGPT), writing assistance (Claude), and image generation (Midjourney). Top earners use AI for 60% of production but keep strategy and editing human.

items.author: Pieter Levels
items.title: Building 12 AI products in 12 months
items.content: Ship fast, AI makes it faster. Built 12 products this year using Claude/GPT for coding, Midjourney for design. Revenue: $180K/month. The pattern: solve your own problem, use AI to build in days not months, launch messy, iterate based on users.

items.author: Nathan Barry / ConvertKit
items.title: Creator Economy Report 2026: AI Adoption Reaches 91%
items.content: 91% of professional creators now use AI tools weekly. Top use cases: content repurposing (72%), email writing (68%), social media scheduling (61%). Key finding: creators using AI earn 2.3x more than those who don't, but authenticity still drives conversions.
